en.headline: Queen Mary Hospital lift contractors suspended from government tendering
en.dek: The Architectural Services Department said the main contractor and lift subcontractor for the new clinical block have been barred from bidding for public works after persistent operational problems with 24 of 28 lifts.
body: The Architectural Services Department said on Friday evening that it had suspended the tendering qualifications of the main contractor and the lift engineering subcontractor for the new Clinical Block 1 at Queen Mary Hospital because of unsatisfactory performance on the lift works.

The department said it attached high importance to the failure of newly installed lifts to operate effectively and would continue to press the contractors, together with the Electrical and Mechanical Services Department, to complete remaining rectification work. Completion is still targeted within the fourth quarter of 2026.

Of the 28 lifts in the building, 24 had experienced more frequent operational problems, including damaged electronic instruments, poor wiring connections, jerky starts and stops, floor-level deviations and doors that failed to open. Clinical services at the block have not yet begun pending stable operation of the facilities. The government reserved the right to pursue claims for any losses arising from the delay.

zh.headline: 瑪麗醫院新大樓升降機承建商及分判商被暫停工務投標資格
zh.dek: 建築署表示，因新裝升降機運作不順，已按合約機制將總承建商及升降機工程分判商的不良表現反映在評核報告，並暫停其參與工務工程投標資格。
body: 建築署周五晚表示，高度重視瑪麗醫院新臨床大樓新裝升降機未能有效運作，已聯同機電工程署嚴格督促承建商及工程分判商完成餘下執修工程，並會進行嚴謹測試和驗收，確保升降機運作穩定。按現時進度，預計本年第四季內完成。
署方已按合約機制，把承建商及工程分判商的不良表現反映在評核報告中，並已暫停其參與工務工程投標的資格。大樓內28部升降機中，有24部出現較多運作不暢順問題，包括電子儀器破損、電線接駁位欠妥、起動或停頓時不暢順、停頓位置與樓層有偏差及門未能打開等。
建築署強調，發現問題時大樓尚未開始提供臨床服務，升降機工程仍處於執漏階段。承建商正進行執修並承擔額外費用，政府會保留追究因工程延誤引致任何損失的權利。
